response.rationale: A Treatment Product is a catalogue item (the product itself), stored in TreatmentProductRepository as Map<string, TreatmentProduct>. A Treatment is one recorded use of a product, read via this.treatments.findAll() in ReportService. ReportService calls TreatmentRepository.findAll and TreatmentProductRepository.findById separately, which suggests a treatment refers to a product rather than being the same thing. TreatmentService likewise has separate registerProduct and recordTreatment methods. They are related but different concepts.
